-- breaks, continues and returns out of loops, each checked by running both versions
do
	local function find(t, x)
		local found = nil
		for i, v in t do
			if v == x then
				found = i
				break
			end
		end
		if found == nil then
			return "none"
		end
		return found
	end
	print(find({1, 5, 3, 5}, 5), find({1, 2}, 9), find({}, 1))
end
do
	local function first_even(n)
		local r
		for i = 1, n do
			if i % 2 == 0 and i > 3 then
				r = i
				break
			end
		end
		return r
	end
	print(first_even(10), first_even(3))
end
do
	local function f(a, t)
		local hit = 0
		if a then
			for _, v in t do
				if v > 2 then
					hit = v
					break
				end
			end
		else
			hit = -1
		end
		return hit * 10
	end
	print(f(true, {1, 3, 4}), f(true, {1}), f(false, {9}))
end
do
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		for j = 1, 4 do
			if j > i then
				break
			end
			if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(out, i * 10 + j)
		end
		if i == 3 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, -i)
	end
	print(table.concat(out, ","))
end
do
	local function g(n)
		local i, s = 0, 0
		while i < n do
			i += 1
			if i % 3 == 0 then
				continue
			end
			if s > 20 then
				break
			end
			s += i
		end
		return i, s
	end
	print(g(5), g(100))
end
do
	local function h(n)
		local i, acc = 0, {}
		repeat
			i += 1
			if i == 2 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(acc, i)
		until i >= n
		return table.concat(acc, " ")
	end
	print(h(5), h(1))
end
do
	local function any_neg(t)
		for _, row in t do
			for _, v in row do
				if v < 0 then
					return true, v
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	print(any_neg({{1, 2}, {3, -4, -5}}), any_neg({{1}}))
end
do
	local fs = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local j = i * 2
		if i == 2 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(fs, function() return i + j end)
	end
	local r = {}
	for _, f in fs do table.insert(r, f()) end
	print(table.concat(r, ","))
end
do
	local function f(list, flag)
		local n = 0
		for _, v in list do
			n += 1
			if v > 10 then
				if flag then
					print("big flag", v)
					return n
				else
					print("big", v)
					return -n
				end
			end
		end
		return 0
	end

		for _, v in list do
			if v == 1 then
				print("one")
				return
			elseif v == 2 then
				print("two")
				return
			end
			print("other", v)
		end
		print("end")
	end
	print(f({1, 2, 30, 40}, true), f({1, 50}, false), f({1}, true))
	g({5, 2, 1}) g({5, 6})
end

-- metamethods: arithmetic, comparison, concat, call, index and newindex functions, len and unm,
-- and the raw functions that skip them
local Vec = {}
Vec.__index = Vec
local function vec(x, y)
	return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Vec)
end
Vec.__add = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end
Vec.__sub = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end
Vec.__mul = function(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return vec(a * b.x, a * b.y)
	end
	return vec(a.x * b, a.y * b)
end
Vec.__unm = function(a)
	return vec(-a.x, -a.y)
end
Vec.__eq = function(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y
end
Vec.__lt = function(a, b)
	return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y
end
Vec.__le = function(a, b)
	return not (b < a)
end
Vec.__len = function(a)
	return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y)
end
Vec.__concat = function(a, b)
	local function s(v)
		return if type(v) == "table" then `({v.x}, {v.y})` else tostring(v)
	end
	return s(a) .. s(b)
end
Vec.__call = function(self, k)
	return self[k]
end
function Vec:dot(o)
	return self.x * o.x + self.y * o.y
end

	end,

-- metamethods: arithmetic, comparison, concat, call, index and newindex functions, len and unm,
-- and the raw functions that skip them
local Vec = {}
Vec.__index = Vec
local function vec(x, y)
	return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Vec)
end
Vec.__add = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end
Vec.__sub = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end
Vec.__mul = function(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return vec(a * b.x, a * b.y)
	end
	return vec(a.x * b, a.y * b)
end
Vec.__unm = function(a)
	return vec(-a.x, -a.y)
end
Vec.__eq = function(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y
end
Vec.__lt = function(a, b)
	return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y
end
Vec.__le = function(a, b)
	return not (b < a)
end
Vec.__len = function(a)
	return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y)
end
Vec.__concat = function(a, b)
	local function s(v)
		return if type(v) == "table" then `({v.x}, {v.y})` else tostring(v)
	end
	return s(a) .. s(b)
end
Vec.__call = function(self, k)
	return self[k]
end
function Vec:dot(o)
	return self.x * o.x + self.y * o.y
end

local a, b = vec(1, 2), vec(3, 4)
local c = a + b
print(c.x, c.y, (a - b).x, (2 * a).y, (a * 3).x, (-a).x)
print(a == vec(1, 2), a ~= b, a < b, a <= b, a > b, b >= a, rawequal(a, vec(1, 2)))
print(#b, a .. b, a .. "!", "v=" .. a, a("y"), a:dot(b), Vec.dot(a, b))

-- __index and __newindex as functions, logging every access
local log = {}
local store = {}
local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(_, k)
		log[#log + 1] = "get " .. tostring(k)
		return store[k]
	end,
	__newindex = function(_, k, v)
		log[#log + 1] = "set " .. tostring(k)
		store[k] = v
	end,
})
proxy.a = 1
proxy.a += 1
proxy[1] = proxy.a * 10
print(proxy.a, proxy[1], rawget(proxy, "a"), table.concat(log, ","))
rawset(proxy, "raw", true)
print(proxy.raw, #log)

-- inheritance through __index chains
local Base = {}
Base.__index = Base
function Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable({ name = name }, Base)
end
function Base:hello()
	return "base " .. self.name
end
local Derived = setmetatable({}, { __index = Base })
Derived.__index = Derived
function Derived.new(name)
	local self = Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable(self, Derived)
end
function Derived:hello()
	return "derived " .. Base.hello(self)
end
local d = Derived.new("d")
print(d:hello(), getmetatable(d) == Derived, Base.hello(d))

-- metamethods: arithmetic, comparison, concat, call, index and newindex functions, len and unm,
-- and the raw functions that skip them
local Vec = {}
Vec.__index = Vec
local function vec(x, y)
	return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Vec)
end
Vec.__add = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end
Vec.__sub = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end
Vec.__mul = function(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return vec(a * b.x, a * b.y)
	end
	return vec(a.x * b, a.y * b)
end
Vec.__unm = function(a)
	return vec(-a.x, -a.y)
end
Vec.__eq = function(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y
end
Vec.__lt = function(a, b)
	return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y
end
Vec.__le = function(a, b)
	return not (b < a)
end
Vec.__len = function(a)
	return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y)
end
Vec.__concat = function(a, b)
	local function s(v)
		return if type(v) == "table" then `({v.x}, {v.y})` else tostring(v)
	end
	return s(a) .. s(b)
end
Vec.__call = function(self, k)
	return self[k]
end
function Vec:dot(o)
	return self.x * o.x + self.y * o.y
end

-- metamethods: arithmetic, comparison, concat, call, index and newindex functions, len and unm,
-- and the raw functions that skip them
local Vec = {}
Vec.__index = Vec
local function vec(x, y)
	return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Vec)
end
Vec.__add = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end
Vec.__sub = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end
Vec.__mul = function(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return vec(a * b.x, a * b.y)
	end
	return vec(a.x * b, a.y * b)
end
Vec.__unm = function(a)
	return vec(-a.x, -a.y)
end
Vec.__eq = function(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y
end
Vec.__lt = function(a, b)
	return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y
end
Vec.__le = function(a, b)
	return not (b < a)
end
Vec.__len = function(a)
	return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y)
end
Vec.__concat = function(a, b)
	local function s(v)
		return if type(v) == "table" then `({v.x}, {v.y})` else tostring(v)
	end
	return s(a) .. s(b)
end
Vec.__call = function(self, k)
	return self[k]
end
function Vec:dot(o)
	return self.x * o.x + self.y * o.y
end

local a, b = vec(1, 2), vec(3, 4)
local c = a + b
print(c.x, c.y, (a - b).x, (2 * a).y, (a * 3).x, (-a).x)
print(a == vec(1, 2), a ~= b, a < b, a <= b, a > b, b >= a, rawequal(a, vec(1, 2)))
print(#b, a .. b, a .. "!", "v=" .. a, a("y"), a:dot(b), Vec.dot(a, b))

-- __index and __newindex as functions, logging every access
local log = {}
local store = {}
local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(_, k)
		log[#log + 1] = "get " .. tostring(k)
		return store[k]
	end,
	__newindex = function(_, k, v)
		log[#log + 1] = "set " .. tostring(k)
		store[k] = v
	end,
})
proxy.a = 1
proxy.a += 1
proxy[1] = proxy.a * 10
print(proxy.a, proxy[1], rawget(proxy, "a"), table.concat(log, ","))
rawset(proxy, "raw", true)
print(proxy.raw, #log)

-- inheritance through __index chains
local Base = {}
Base.__index = Base
function Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable({ name = name }, Base)
end
function Base:hello()
	return "base " .. self.name
end
local Derived = setmetatable({}, { __index = Base })
Derived.__index = Derived
function Derived.new(name)
	local self = Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable(self, Derived)
end
function Derived:hello()
	return "derived " .. Base.hello(self)
end
local d = Derived.new("d")
print(d:hello(), getmetatable(d) == Derived, Base.hello(d))

-- multiple assignment and multiple returns: every right-hand side is read before anything is
-- assigned, a call in the middle of a list is cut to one value, and parentheses cut it too
local function three()
	return 1, 2, 3
end
local function none() end

local a, b, c = 1, 2, 3
a, b, c = c, a, b
print(a, b, c)

local t = { 10, 20, 30 }
local i = 1
i, t[i] = i + 1, "x" -- the index is read before i changes
print(i, t[1], t[2])

local x, y, z = three(), 10
print(x, y, z)
print((three()))
print(three(), three())
print(#{ three(), three() }, #{ (three()), three() }, select("#", none()), select("#", (none())))

local function count(...)
	return select("#", ...)
end
print(count(nil, nil), count(none()), count(none(), nil), count(three()))

local function tail(...)
	local first, rest = ..., select(2, ...)
	return first, rest, select(-1, ...)
end
print(tail(4, 5, 6))

-- a swap through a table and a local in one statement
local cell = { v = 1 }
local held = 2
cell.v, held = held, cell.v
print(cell.v, held)

-- varargs captured into a table with holes
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end
local p = pack(1, nil, 3, nil)
print(p.n, p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])

-- assignment to a local that a later expression in the same list reads
local m = 1
local n
m, n = m + 1, m
print(m, n)

-- compound assignment whose index expression has a side effect, evaluated once
local calls = 0
local function idx()
	calls += 1
	return 2
end
local arr = { 1, 2, 3 }
arr[idx()] += 10
arr[idx()] ..= ""
print(arr[2], calls)

-- multiple assignment and multiple returns: every right-hand side is read before anything is
-- assigned, a call in the middle of a list is cut to one value, and parentheses cut it too
local function three()
	return 1, 2, 3
end
local function none() end

local a, b, c = 1, 2, 3
a, b, c = c, a, b
print(a, b, c)

local t = { 10, 20, 30 }
local i = 1
i, t[i] = i + 1, "x" -- the index is read before i changes
print(i, t[1], t[2])

local x, y, z = three(), 10
print(x, y, z)
print((three()))
print(three(), three())
print(#{ three(), three() }, #{ (three()), three() }, select("#", none()), select("#", (none())))

local function count(...)
	return select("#", ...)
end
print(count(nil, nil), count(none()), count(none(), nil), count(three()))

local function tail(...)
	local first, rest = ..., select(2, ...)
	return first, rest, select(-1, ...)
end
print(tail(4, 5, 6))

-- a swap through a table and a local in one statement
local cell = { v = 1 }
local held = 2
cell.v, held = held, cell.v
print(cell.v, held)

-- varargs captured into a table with holes
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end
local p = pack(1, nil, 3, nil)
print(p.n, p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])

-- assignment to a local that a later expression in the same list reads
local m = 1
local n
m, n = m + 1, m
print(m, n)

-- compound assignment whose index expression has a side effect, evaluated once
local calls = 0
local function idx()
	calls += 1
	return 2
end
local arr = { 1, 2, 3 }
arr[idx()] += 10
arr[idx()] ..= ""
print(arr[2], calls)

-- multiple assignment and multiple returns: every right-hand side is read before anything is
-- assigned, a call in the middle of a list is cut to one value, and parentheses cut it too
local function three()
	return 1, 2, 3
end
local function none() end

local a, b, c = 1, 2, 3
a, b, c = c, a, b
print(a, b, c)

local t = { 10, 20, 30 }
local i = 1
i, t[i] = i + 1, "x" -- the index is read before i changes
print(i, t[1], t[2])

local x, y, z = three(), 10
print(x, y, z)
print((three()))
print(three(), three())
print(#{ three(), three() }, #{ (three()), three() }, select("#", none()), select("#", (none())))

local function count(...)
	return select("#", ...)
end
print(count(nil, nil), count(none()), count(none(), nil), count(three()))

local function tail(...)
	local first, rest = ..., select(2, ...)
	return first, rest, select(-1, ...)
end
print(tail(4, 5, 6))

-- a swap through a table and a local in one statement
local cell = { v = 1 }
local held = 2
cell.v, held = held, cell.v
print(cell.v, held)

-- varargs captured into a table with holes
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end
local p = pack(1, nil, 3, nil)
print(p.n, p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])

-- assignment to a local that a later expression in the same list reads
local m = 1
local n
m, n = m + 1, m
print(m, n)

-- compound assignment whose index expression has a side effect, evaluated once
local calls = 0
local function idx()
	calls += 1
	return 2
end
local arr = { 1, 2, 3 }
arr[idx()] += 10
arr[idx()] ..= ""
print(arr[2], calls)

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- a guard whose branches both fall through, around a comparison with a constant on the left
local count = 0
for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end
print("count", count)

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- a guard whose branches both fall through, around a comparison with a constant on the left
local count = 0
for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end
print("count", count)

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end

entries.source:
-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- a guard whose branches both fall through, around a comparison with a constant on the left
local count = 0
for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end
print("count", count)

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do

				return true
			end

	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end

	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

local base = 3
local exponent = 0.5
local half = 2 ^ exponent
local cube = base ^ 3
local square = base ^ 2
local huge = math.huge
local nan = 0 / 0

local function power(b, e)
	return b ^ e
end

print(half, cube, square, power(base, 3), power(2, exponent))
print(huge, -huge, nan ~= nan, 1 / -huge)
print(7 // 2, -7 // 2, 7 % -3, 2 ^ -1)
print(0x10, 1e3, 1.5e-3, 123456789012)

local acc = 1
for i = 1, 5 do
	acc *= i
	acc += 0.5
end
print(acc)

local message = `{base} cubed is {cube}, {#"four"} letters`
print(message)

local base = 3
local exponent = 0.5
local half = 2 ^ exponent
local cube = base ^ 3
local square = base ^ 2
local huge = math.huge
local nan = 0 / 0

local function power(b, e)
	return b ^ e
end

print(half, cube, square, power(base, 3), power(2, exponent))
print(huge, -huge, nan ~= nan, 1 / -huge)
print(7 // 2, -7 // 2, 7 % -3, 2 ^ -1)
print(0x10, 1e3, 1.5e-3, 123456789012)

local acc = 1
for i = 1, 5 do
	acc *= i
	acc += 0.5
end
print(acc)

local message = `{base} cubed is {cube}, {#"four"} letters`
print(message)

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end
print(savings:statement())

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end
print(savings:statement())

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end
print(savings:statement())

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end
print(savings:statement())

		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))

end

print(order("a", "b"))
print(order(2, 2))

-- precedence and arithmetic corners a printer has to parenthesize or keep apart: unary minus
-- against ^, not against ==, right-associative .. and ^, and Luau's floor division and modulo with
-- negative and fractional operands
local values = { 7, -7, 2.5, -2.5, 0.5, 3 }
for _, a in ipairs(values) do
	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do
		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))
print(1 .. 2, 1 .. 2 .. 3, "a" .. 1 + 2, ("a" .. 1) .. 2)
print(x < y == true, (x < y) == true, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x * y % 4, x * (y % 4))

print(7 // 0, -7 // 0, 0 / 0 ~= 0 / 0, -7 % math.huge, 7 % -math.huge)

	return v

	return a < b, a > b, b < a, a <= b, not (a > b), a == b, a ~= b
end

print(order("a", "b"))

-- precedence and arithmetic corners a printer has to parenthesize or keep apart: unary minus
-- against ^, not against ==, right-associative .. and ^, and Luau's floor division and modulo with
-- negative and fractional operands
local values = { 7, -7, 2.5, -2.5, 0.5, 3 }
for _, a in ipairs(values) do
	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do
		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))
print(1 .. 2, 1 .. 2 .. 3, "a" .. 1 + 2, ("a" .. 1) .. 2)
print(x < y == true, (x < y) == true, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x * y % 4, x * (y % 4))
print(#"abc" + 1, #{ 1, 2 } * 2, -#"ab", #("a" .. "bc"))
print(7 // 0, -7 // 0, 0 / 0 ~= 0 / 0, -7 % math.huge, 7 % -math.huge)
print(2 ^ 53 + 1, 2 ^ 63, -2 ^ 63, 1e308 * 10, -1e308 * 10)

-- the same expressions on values the compiler can't fold
local function id(v)
	return v
end
local p, q = id(-7), id(2)
print(p // q, p % q, -p ^ q, (p .. q), p < q and "lt" or "ge", not (p < q))

-- comparisons the printer might swap or merge
local function order(a, b)
	return a < b, a > b, b < a, a <= b, not (a > b), a == b, a ~= b
end
print(order(1, 2))
print(order("a", "b"))
print(order(2, 2))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-13 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-13 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list

		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)

	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end
